note: Export activity is factually confirmed by dated Indian customs records with B/L numbers and destinations (Australia 2026-01-23 B/L 9023398; Serbia 2025-10-07 B/L 8855350; Ecuador 2025-10-05 B/L 1495242; USA 2025-07-15 B/L 3564218). Company also imports (drilled rollers from Shandong Jintai Rolls, China, 2025-07-01) — i.e. it is a manufacturer_trader profile: builds 'SANTEC MAKE' presses in India and imports components.
